200007.desc:
[Special Challenge] Successfully defeat 1 <color=#FFAF2C>Clone</color> of Integrated - Haytor

[Stage Overview]
During combat, the Boss will alternate between two enhanced states: "Frenzy" and "Phantom." When the Boss's <color=#FFAF2C>Daze</color> accumulates to a certain level, it will <color=#FFAF2C>summon Clones,</color> during which <color=#FFAF2C>Daze cannot be accumulated</color>. Agents must defeat its Clones within a time limit — each Clone defeated accumulates the Boss's Daze and <color=#FFAF2C>greatly increases its Stun DMG Multiplier and the Sheer DMG it receives</color>. If all Clones are not eliminated in time, the Boss will absorb the remaining Clones and resume its offensive.

200009.desc:
[Special Challenge] Inflict <color=#FFAF2C>Snapfreeze</color> on Integrated - Infernal Revenant 4 times

[Stage Overview]
When the Boss enters combat, it will have a Molten Crystal Barrier. When an Agent triggers a Defensive Assist or Dodge Counter, or inflicts an Ice Attribute Anomaly on the Boss, the <color=#FFAF2C>Boss's Molten Crystal Barrier</color> will be reduced. When the Molten Crystal Barrier is fully depleted, the Boss will immediately enter a Stunned state.
During combat, pressing the Special Attack button will put the current Agent into the <color=#FFAF2C>Subzero Barrier</color> state for 0.5 seconds. While Subzero Barrier is active, receiving a red-light attack from the Boss will Negate that attack and reduce the <color=#FFAF2C>Boss's Molten Crystal Barrier</color>. If the Boss is currently under the <color=#FFAF2C>Burn</color> Anomaly state, it will additionally deal DMG based on max HP.
While the Boss is Stunned, pressing the Special Attack button will inflict the <color=#FFAF2C>Snapfreeze</color> effect on the Boss, dealing DMG based on max HP. After an Agent triggers an Attribute Anomaly, the Special Attack button's cooldown will be additionally refreshed.

200011.desc:
[Special Challenge] Stun Integrated - Sacrifice - Heretic Jester within 60 seconds
 
[Stage Overview]
During combat, the Boss will summon <color=#FFAF2C>Reward Magic Box</color>, <color=#FFAF2C>Trap Magic Box</color>, and <color=#FFAF2C>Frenzy Magic Box</color>.
When an Agent triggers the Reward Magic Box, the Boss will not launch any attacks, and all Agents on the whole squad will receive <color=#FFAF2C>Energy, Adrenaline, Sharpness, and Decibels</color> every second.
When an Agent triggers the Trap Magic Box, the Boss will launch attacks, and parrying all of the Boss's attacks will <color=#FFAF2C>accumulate 50% Daze</color>.
When an Agent triggers the Frenzy Magic Box, the Boss will activate its Miasmic Shield and launch a fierce series of attacks. Parry all of the Boss's attacks to <color=#FFAF2C>Break the Miasmic Shield</color> and make it <color=#FFAF2C>Stunned</color>.
Whenever the attacks following a Frenzy Magic Box trigger are successfully parried and the enemy is stunned, the Boss's <color=#FFAF2C>DEF is reduced by 30%</color> and the whole squad's Agents gain a <color=#FFAF2C>30% CRIT DMG increase</color>, lasting until the enemy's Stun ends.
Whenever the attacks following a Trap Magic Box trigger are successfully parried and the enemy is stunned, the Boss's <color=#FFAF2C>DEF is reduced by 15%</color> and the whole squad's Agents gain a <color=#FFAF2C>15% CRIT DMG increase</color>, lasting until the enemy's Stun ends.
After the Boss recovers from the Stun, it will hurl several throwing knives into the air; parrying all throwing knives will <color=#FFAF2C>accumulate a large amount of Daze</color>.
